name: Watch Me Take It Back
overview: For ten years, Ximena Suárez lived a nightmare after being stripped of her identity by Rosa Soler through a swap scheme. Now, she returns transformed as Elisa Gil, gradually exposing the greed of the woman who stole her life and reclaiming what was always hers: her name, her history, and her family's love. Fate always finds its balance: justice arrives, falsehoods crumble, and honest perseverance ultimately blossoms.
